outcomes.read-an-array: Read an element of an array by its index

the-problem.title: Finding one number
the-problem.caption: You have a row of numbers and need the second one. Scanning from the start feels slow.

how-it-works.title: Jump straight to it
how-it-works.caption: An array stores its cells side by side, so the index tells you exactly where to look.

which-index.prompt: Which index holds the highlighted number?
which-index.explanation: Indexes start at 0, so the second cell has index 1.

array.gloss: A row of cells stored side by side and read by index.
